name: Lough Gur
lore: Lough Gur, the enchanted lake. The Earl sleeps under it with his army, and Aine sits on its shore combing her hair. Now there are lights on the water at night, and the lake people say the goddess has come back. She hasn't: the lights are the Glimmer, come north out of the Sheeroe Hills, and they are waking everything that sleeps in the lake.

chains.title: The Gurite Raiders
chains.hint: Smoke over the Gurite Hills: the bandits are gathering for a raid on the south road...

stages.name: Clear Gurite Camp
stages.objective: Clear the gurite camp
stages.announce: The gurites are massing at their camp in the hills for a raid on the south road. Break them before they ride - the Sentinels will thank you.
stages.success: You have cleared the gurite camp. Gurite Warchief Donnan comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the gurite camp. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: Gurite Warchief Donnan
stages.objective: Defeat Gurite Warchief Donnan
stages.announce: Gurite Warchief Donnan stands at the gurite camp. Bring friends.
stages.success: Gurite Warchief Donnan falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: Gurite Warchief Donnan slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Gurites Hold the South Road
stages.objective: Drive the gurite raiders off the road
stages.announce: The gurites hold the south road at the old road post, and they are stopping everyone. Drive them out.
stages.success: The gurite raiders are gone from the road. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Keep Sentinel Brogan alive while he raises the road post again
stages.announce: Sentinel Brogan of Ceannai has come out to raise the road post again. The gurites are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The gurite raiders break and scatter. The road is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Aine falls, and the gurite raiders take the road back.

chains.title: The Luch Swarm
chains.hint: The North Fields are alive with luch - Eithne's mill is under siege...

stages.name: Protect Eithne the Miller
stages.objective: Protect Eithne the Miller, who is sealing the grain store
stages.announce: The luch are swarming the mill. Eithne the miller must seal the grain store - hold them off her.
stages.success: "That's done," says Eithne the Miller. "They came from over there - let's finish this."
stages.fail: Eithne the Miller falls. The attackers are left to do as they please - for now.

stages.name: Clear Mill
stages.objective: Clear the mill
stages.announce: They came from the mill. Follow them back and clear it out.
stages.success: You have cleared the mill. The Great Luch comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the mill. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: Luchtigern's Get
stages.objective: Defeat Luchtigern's Get
stages.announce: Out of the burrow comes one of Luchtigern's own get - a mouse the size of a calf. Bring friends.
stages.success: Luchtigern's Get falls. Somewhere in the fields, something squeals with rage.
stages.fail: The Great Luch slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Greater Luches Hold the Road
stages.objective: Drive the greater luches off the road
stages.announce: With The Luch Swarm lost, the greater luches have spread down onto the road and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The greater luches are gone from the road. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Keep Eithne the Miller alive while she seals the grain store
stages.announce: Eithne the Miller has come back to seal her grain store. The luch are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The greater luches break and scatter. The road is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Ruadh falls, and the greater luches take the road back.

chains.title: The Cluricaun Revel
chains.hint: Drunken singing from the cluricauns' camp by the luch runs...

stages.name: Clear Revel
stages.objective: Clear the revel
stages.announce: The cluricauns are revelling at their camp by the luch runs - drinking stolen ale and riding stolen luch. Aine's Circle says a revel like this calls things up out of the lake. Break it up.
stages.success: You have cleared the revel. Old Cluricaun Ruadh comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the revel. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: Old Cluricaun Ruadh
stages.objective: Defeat Old Cluricaun Ruadh
stages.announce: Old Cluricaun Ruadh stands at the revel. Bring friends.
stages.success: Old Cluricaun Ruadh falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: Old Cluricaun Ruadh slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Cluricauns Hold the Road
stages.objective: Drive the cluricauns off the road
stages.announce: With The Cluricaun Revel lost, the cluricauns have spread down onto the road and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The cluricauns are gone from the road. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Cormac, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Cormac has come out to set the road right. The cluricauns are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The cluricauns break and scatter. The road is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Cormac falls, and the cluricauns take the road back.

chains.title: The Ferryman's Crossing
chains.hint: Gurites are watching the ferry below Innis Carthaig...

stages.name: Protect Ferryman Colm
stages.objective: Protect Ferryman Colm, who is caulking his ferry
stages.announce: Gurites are coming down on the ferry below Innis Carthaig. Ferryman Colm has to get his boat off the shore - keep them off him.
stages.success: "That's done," says Ferryman Colm. "They came from over there - let's finish this."
stages.fail: Ferryman Colm falls. The attackers are left to do as they please - for now.

stages.name: Clear Gurite Camp
stages.objective: Clear the gurite camp
stages.announce: They came from the gurite camp. Follow them back and clear it out.
stages.success: You have cleared the gurite camp. Gurite Captain Orlagh comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the gurite camp. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: Gurite Captain Orlagh
stages.objective: Defeat Gurite Captain Orlagh
stages.announce: Gurite Captain Orlagh stands at the gurite camp. Bring friends.
stages.success: Gurite Captain Orlagh falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: Gurite Captain Orlagh slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Gurite Assailers Hold the Old Road
stages.objective: Drive the gurite assailers off the old road
stages.announce: With The Ferryman's Crossing lost, the gurite assailers have spread down onto the old road and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The gurite assailers are gone from the old road. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Aine, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Aine has come out to set the old road right. The gurite assailers are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the old road is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The gurite assailers break and scatter. The old road is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Aine falls, and the gurite assailers take the road back.

chains.title: Lights on the Lake
chains.hint: Pale lights on Lough Gur - and the touched folk are walking toward them...

stages.name: The Lure
stages.objective: Put out the light leading the touched folk to the water
stages.announce: A light has come up off the lake and is drifting toward the touched folk's camp - and the touched are following it, singing, down to the water. Put the light out before it reaches the shore!
stages.success: The lure goes out like a pinched candle. The touched stop, and blink, and one of them starts to cry.
stages.fail: The lure sinks into the lake, and the touched walk in after it.

stages.name: the Lantern on the Water
stages.objective: Defeat the Lantern on the Water
stages.announce: Out on the water, a bigger light turns toward you: the one the lures come from. It comes ashore. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Lantern breaks into sparks that hiss out in the shallows. The lake is dark again - for tonight.
stages.fail: The Lantern drifts back out over the water.

stages.name: The Drowned Walk the Shore
stages.objective: Lay the drowned touched to rest
stages.announce: The touched who walked into the lake have walked out again - drowned, and lit from inside. They are on the west shore. Lay them to rest.
stages.success: The last of the drowned lies down in the reeds and is still.

chains.title: The Earl's Ride
chains.hint: The lake has gone still as glass. Somewhere under it, a horse is stamping...

stages.name: The Earl Rides
stages.objective: Turn the Earl back before he rides the whole shore
stages.announce: Lough Gur has gone still. Then it breaks, and a rider comes up out of it on a horse shod with silver: Gearoid Iarla, the Earl, with his host behind him. He will ride the shore round to Innis Carthaig, halting three times. Turn him back under the lake!
stop_says: The Earl reins in on the west shore, and his host comes down off their horses round him. Fight them here!
The Earl halts at the north shore. The dullahans dismount - and the black wraiths come with them.
The Earl halts above Innis Carthaig, the last of his ride. Now - or he takes the shore!
stages.success: Gearoid Iarla reels in the saddle and turns his horse to the water. 'Not yet,' he says, to no one. 'The shoes are not yet worn.' The lake closes over him, and his host after him.
stages.fail: The Earl reaches Innis Carthaig's shore and his host spreads out along it. They will not go back tonight.

stages.name: The Earl's Host Holds the Shore
stages.objective: Drive the Earl's host back into the lake
stages.announce: The Earl's host holds the west shore of Lough Gur. Every night nobody answers, they will be stronger. Drive them back into the water!
stages.success: The host breaks and goes back under the water.

chains.title: The Fairy Taking
chains.hint: A traveller on the moor road - and weeping in the wood beside it...

stages.name: The Taking
stages.objective: Stop the fairies carrying the traveller into the Sorrowing Wood
stages.announce: The melancholic fairies have taken a traveller off the moor road and are carrying her into the Sorrowing Wood - to sit in their queen's empty chair. Stop the bearer before she's gone!
stages.success: The bearer falls, and the traveller - a girl from Innis Carthaig - sits up in the bracken and asks what happened.
stages.fail: The fairies carry her into the wood. Nobody sees her again.

stages.name: the Grieving Knight
stages.objective: Defeat the Grieving Knight
stages.announce: The queen's knight comes out of the wood, weeping, for the one who stopped them. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Grieving Knight falls, still weeping.
stages.fail: The Grieving Knight goes back into the wood.

chains.title: Deamhan Night
chains.hint: Hounds baying on the moor - the Sentinels' road post has lit its signal fire...

stages.name: The Road Post
stages.objective: Keep Sentinel Orla alive at the road post until dawn's first watch
stages.announce: The deamhan are up on the moor, and they are coming for the Sentinels' road post. Sentinel Orla has lit the signal fire - hold the post with her!
stages.thanks: "They went back into the dark. Thank you. I'll let the fire burn down now."
stages.success: The deamhan pull back - all but one, bigger than the rest, that comes up the road on its own.
stages.fail: The post falls, and the moor is the deamhan's.

stages.name: the Moor-Tormentor
stages.objective: Defeat the Moor-Tormentor
stages.announce: The Moor-Tormentor comes up the road for the fire. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Tormentor falls, and the moor goes quiet.
stages.fail: The Tormentor scatters the fire.

chains.title: The Azure Burning
chains.hint: Torches on the road from the south-east - the Azure are coming for the touched folk's camp...

stages.name: The Touched Folk's Camp
stages.objective: Keep Druid Siofra alive while she leads the touched folk away
stages.announce: The Order of the Azure has come to burn the touched folk's camp, with the touched folk in it - 'already lost', they say. Druid Siofra of Aine's Circle is leading them out. Keep the crusaders off her!
stages.thanks: "They're out. All of them. Touched, not lost - there's a difference, and the Azure never learned it."
stages.success: The touched folk are safe in the trees. The crusaders' captain comes on alone, with a torch.
stages.fail: The camp burns.

stages.name: Brother-Captain Ultan
stages.objective: Defeat Brother-Captain Ultan
stages.announce: Brother-Captain Ultan of the Azure: 'The Glimmer touched them. What the Glimmer touches, we burn. Stand aside or burn with them.' Bring friends.

boss.name: Brother-Captain Ultan
boss.guild: of the Order of the Azure

stages.success: Brother-Captain Ultan falls. His torch goes out in the wet grass.
stages.fail: Ultan's crusaders put the camp to the torch.
